What's New in V 1.70

  • ⚡ Added streaming transcription support (Nova 3, Scribe V2, Soniox V4, and Mistral Real-time)
  • 🔄 Added dictionary sync support across devices
  • 📝 Added live transcript display (only available for notch recorder)
  • 🎵 Added support for AMR, OGG, OGA, Opus, and 3GP audio file formats
  • ✨ Added new Mistral transcription model
  • ✂️ Added configurable filler word removal option
  • 💬 Added prompt picker in transcript history
  • 🧹 Fixed audio cleanup bug
  • 📋 Fixed clipboard issue
  • 🐛 Bug fixes and minor improvements
